payload.explanation: Use the built-in clock's format setting instead of a new clock plugin.

steps: Record the existing built-in clock format before changing it.
Set the built-in clock format with: omarchy bar set omarchy.clock format 'dddd MM/dd/yyyy h:mm AP'.
Confirm the saved shell configuration and visible clock show the desired weekday, date and AM/PM time.

payload.effects: Changes only the displayed clock format, not the system clock or timezone.
payload.rollback: Restore the previously saved format; the prior date-and-time-only format was MM/dd/yyyy h:mm AP and the packaged format recorded in the journal was dddd HH:mm.
payload.validation_plan: Preserve the previous setting, apply only after approval, then perform the final check in the procedure on the actual system.

activation.details: Apply the setting and perform its documented local check; this record does not execute it.
